title: Relationship Authority Graph Candidate
hard_laws: Privileged memory or erased-timeline intimacy does not create current consent.
Rescue, wealth, authority or employment power does not create emotional debt that substitutes for choice.
Relationship state is current-state data; prior-cycle/history can be remembered by a character only if canon allows it, but cannot be silently inherited by the other party.
Repair requires changed behavior or boundary, not a correct speech alone.

n26_stress_results.expected: prior intimacy stored as one-sided knowledge asymmetry; consent resets to NOT_ESTABLISHED for non-remembering partner
power edge remains active until employment/status leverage is genuinely removed or consent context is independently safe
rescue creates gratitude/context, not romantic obligation
resources may change access/risk but cannot buy trust/consent
evidence access and duty can conflict with intimacy; professional authority cannot be used as romantic shortcut
